Gallery View

Crabstar

6 Bedrooms 6 Full Bathrooms 1 Half Bathrooms 18 Sleeps Inlet Beach
  • Description
  • Amenities
  • Reviews
  • Calendar
  • Location

Home Highlights:
- Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day between Oct 1 - May 1)
- Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31
- Elevator
- 6 Seater Golf Cart Included
- 6 Adult Bicycles Included
- Short Walk to the Beach

Experience coastal living at its finest at Crabstar, a brand-new luxury estate nestled in the heart of Inlet Beach, Florida. Just steps from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf and situated along iconic 30A, this meticulously designed home is a coastal sanctuary where refined design meets laid-back elegance.

This three-story retreat features 6 bedrooms, 6.5 bathrooms, and was thoughtfully designed to comfortably accommodate large families or groups while offering privacy, comfort, and style throughout. The open-concept main floor showcases a stunning chef’s kitchen complete with natural shaker cabinetry, Calacatta Ultra quartz countertops, and Thermador appliances, flowing seamlessly into a spacious dining and living area with custom trim, accent walls, and elegant lighting. The expansive porches and outdoor areas offer the perfect backdrop for morning coffee or evening cocktails, while the private heated pool and fenced yard provide resort-style amenities just steps from your door.

Each floor features ensuite bedrooms with spa-like bathrooms, including three luxurious master suites adorned with quartz vanities, rainfall showers, and soaking tubs. Custom bunk rooms and dual laundry rooms make family travel easy, while high-end finishes like brilliant white shaker cabinetry, chrome fixtures, and designer lighting elevate every space.

Additional highlights include an elevator, wet bar with beverage fridge, multiple covered porches, private garage, and curated interiors by Home and Harmony. Whether you're here to relax poolside, explore 30A’s dining and shops, or spend your days on the beach, Crabstar is your unforgettable home base.

Sleeping Arrangements
First Floor
King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only
Queen and Twin Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only

Second Floor
Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only
King Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo
2 Twin over Twin and 1 Twin over Queen Bunkroom, Private Bathroom, Shower Only

Third Floor
Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate
1/2 Bathroom

March 25, 2026 - Website

Amazing Brand New House

by Jessica Wirka
This house is a winner! We stayed here last fall and it\'s hands-down our favorite rental on 30A. It\'s large enough to comfortably accommodate several families and yet maintains a cozy, intimate vibe thanks to the beautiful furnishings and decor. The upstairs open-plan kitchen and deck area are fabulous, with a view of the ocean. The beach is very close, the pool is lovely and having a golf cart and bikes included was a game-changer - everything you might need has been thought of. We\'ll be back!
March 24, 2026 - Website

Stunning New Beach House

by Amy Hornby
We have stayed at several properties on 30A over the years, and you never know if the pictures are going to match the reality of the property when you get there. Crabstar blew us and all expectations we had away. It is beautifully decorated, well laid out, spacious, and close to the beach. Everything in the house is not only brand new but thoughtfully curated to make your experience special. It is the perfect house to accommodate a vacation with friends or family with its multiple gathering spots, large kitchen, elevator, pool and the ocean view on the upper deck. I cannot say enough about this house! We cannot wait to come back!
